title: Software Engineer
jd:
About the Company Betta is a fast-growing technology company building modern digital products that help businesses streamline their operations and connect with customers more effectively. With a distributed, remote-first team spread across multiple time zones, Betta fosters a culture of trust, autonomy, and continuous learning, encouraging engineers to take ownership of meaningful problems from day one.
About the Role We are looking for a Software Engineer with around 4 years of experience to join our remote engineering team. In this role, you will work closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to design, build, and maintain scalable software solutions that power our core platform. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on a product used by thousands of customers while growing your technical and professional skills.
Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain robust, well-tested code across the full stack. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and sprint planning. Troubleshoot and resolve production issues in a timely manner. Contribute to improving engineering practices, tooling, and documentation. Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge across the team.
Requirements Approximately 4 years of professional software engineering experience. Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and familiarity with modern web frameworks. Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles. Experience working with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and version control systems such as Git. Excellent communication skills and comfort working in a fully remote, asynchronous environment. A collaborative mindset and eagerness to learn new technologies.
Benefits Fully remote work with flexible hours. Competitive compensation package. Generous paid time off and company holidays. Home office setup allowance. Health and wellness benefits. Opportunities for professional development, including conference attendance and learning stipends. A supportive, inclusive team culture that values work-life balance.
